_comment: Synthetic payloads. Sanitized illustrative example — not production source.
These are NOT any real provider's schema. Field names are invented for
illustration; the real gateway contract is not reproduced.
All identifiers come from reserved documentation ranges: the +254700000000
test block, RFC 5737 TEST-NET addresses, and *.example.test domains.

payment_notification_duplicate_redeliver._note: Identical id. Must return the same response and must NOT re-enqueue.

payment_notification_unparseable_amount._note: Must return 4xx and alert. Returning 200 here means money received and never credited.

rendered_notification._note: The application renders the finished text; the transport interpolates nothing. Dates are arbitrary and imply no cycle length.
rendered_notification.body: Payment of KES 2,500.00 received. Your service is active until 09 Mar.

ops_agent_tool_call._note: Shape of a read-only tool call. Values illustrative.
ops_agent_tool_call._calibration_note: limit was reached — a well-calibrated answer must say so
